title: Status Badge Label
prompt: A React badge shows friendly text for a loading status. Write a helper that maps "idle" to "Ready", "loading" to "Loading...", "success" to "Done", and "error" to "Needs attention".

explanation.beginner:
Example: statusBadgeLabel("idle") produces "Ready". Map each explicitly supported state to its exact output text or value. Separate state selection from formatting.

Compare “labels loading”: input ["loading"] produces "Loading...". Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
Map each explicitly supported state to its exact output text or value. Separate state selection from formatting.

Tempting mistake: Capitalization, whitespace, and boolean-versus-string output are part of the contract; truthiness alone may combine distinct states.

Trace the branch conditions and any accumulator or lookup after each input. Keep the return contract separate from how it is calculated.

Regression check: preserve the contract illustrated by “labels loading”, then change one boundary in a new test. The solution below is one implementation; another is valid when it preserves the same behavior.
